authorization.request: Make daily automatic scan records visible on the official DSH STORE website; only manual scans currently appear.
authorization.scope: Fix the automatic scan history data URL, add deterministic regression coverage, and publish the fix to both storefronts after CI and Pages validation. No Catalog/Candidate writes, no scan dispatch, no author outreach, no DSH Profile changes, and no third-party code execution.

implementation.dataSource: Use the already-published GitHub Pages automation-status.json endpoint, matching the homepage and plugin directory. It is refreshed by the existing Pages build every three hours and returns the latest eight Catalog automation runs; its public response permits cross-origin browser reads.
implementation.publicBoundary: Only public run summaries and existing aggregate reports are exposed. Missing evidence remains unavailable and is never rendered as zero. No per-repository raw scan data is added.
implementation.releaseBoundary: Keep automation-status.json outside the production release manifest so run-only refreshes do not alter the immutable static release. The scan page fetches this separately from the canonical Pages endpoint.

deterministicGates: static marketplace build asserts the scan page points to the published automation-status.json endpoint
contract test prevents regression to a same-origin URL that is absent from custom-domain releases
verify production Pages automation-status.json has recentScanRuns and Access-Control-Allow-Origin permits storefront reads
after release, verify both custom-domain scan pages and their fetched JSON source are publicly available

rollback.reference: Revert the single implementation commit through an audited PR, then run the existing serial storefront refresh. Existing deployments retain backups, atomic current symlink switching, health checks, and automatic rollback.

externalEffects: One auditable source PR, GitHub Pages build, then serial international and domestic storefront refreshes; no workflow_dispatch for scanning and no changes to Catalog/Candidate data.
